gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-georama: Georama reads wide and friendly, its c opening like a bracelet pulled apart while the capitals barely rise above the lowercase. And Woodgod, a vintage display face, brings a commanding weight that makes the quieter body feel even more at ease.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-gidole: Gidole draws every stroke like neon tubing, with a high midline.  Its terminals stay apart like open scissor blades, so a long block of it reads clean and unhurried beneath the vintage, commanding thickness of Woodgod.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-golos-text: Vintage swagger meets modern plainness here. Golos Text keeps a steady pen pressure and a widely parted s, so a long passage glides along while Woodgod's wide-channeled bowls stay up top.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-hedvig-letters-san: Woodgod comes in vintage and commanding, its lowercase nearly reaching the capitals. Hedvig Letters Sans echoes that tall stance in friendlier, contemporary sans-serif form, and that shared height is what ties the two together.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-heebo: Heebo reads as a tall central band of text, its curves stopping short instead of closing in. Woodgod's vintage display bowls sit above it, loud where the body is quiet.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-hind-guntur: Stamped-metal sturdiness, top to bottom. Hind Guntur draws every stroke with one fixed nib and leaves wide gaps where curves meet stems, a stark foil to the commanding, vintage Woodgod.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-hind-madurai: Vintage punch above, ribbon-smooth lines below. Hind Madurai keeps uninterrupted monoline strokes and s curves that open wide at both ends, so a long page of it moves along easily.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru presses its lowercase tops close to the ascender height and leaves each a with its mouth ajar, without calligraphic thinning. Woodgod handles the commanding vintage display work; this sans-serif handles the text.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri hums along at a constant line weight, like sign-shop vinyl, with rounds that gap like a cracked bangle. But Woodgod earns its keep where the words are big and short, its wide-channeled bowls looking vintage and commanding.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-hind-vadodara: Hind Vadodara keeps its thickness constant in every direction, with spacious terminal gaps and open-looking e and a shapes. Hind Vadodara has tall bowls that can handle a modest size, while commanding, vintage Woodgod takes the larger sizes.
